svg.title: October Fed hold readings on October 14 evening and October 15
svg.desc: Kalshi maintain-rate Chance heading rose from 69% to 71%; Polymarket No change named row rose from 69% to 74%. Page accesses about 19:04 UTC October 14 and 13:34 UTC October 15; quote times unknown.
svg.text: October hold: two dated page checks
Earlier: Oct 14 19:04 UTC (light) · Later: Oct 15 13:34 UTC (dark)
Separate venues. BLS PPI: Oct 15 at 12:30 UTC. Quote times unavailable.
Sources: Kalshi Chance headings and Polymarket named rows, accessed Oct 14–15, 2026.
